name: Product assistant
description: Routes each message: product questions are rewritten into a search query, searched and answered; order questions get a fixed reply; small talk gets a short friendly answer.

categories.name: product_question
categories.description: Questions about products: features, prices, comparisons, recommendations, availability
examples: Which phone has the best camera?
Is it cheaper than the other one?

categories.name: order_status
categories.description: Questions about an existing order, delivery, payment or a refund

params.system_prompt: Rewrite the user's last message as a short, standalone search query for a product catalog. Use the conversation to resolve words like "it" or "the cheaper one". Reply with the query only.

params.text: Sorry, I couldn't find a matching product. Could you describe what you're looking for in another way?
I can't look up orders yet. Please contact our support team at support@example.com and they'll help you right away.

params.system_prompt: You are a friendly assistant for an online shop. Reply briefly and warmly, and offer to help the user find a product. Answer in the user's language.
